recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white urban scene viewed through a window, framed by a raw cardboard-textured border, featuring a layered, distressed typographic lockup on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black and white photography against a neutral tan border
Juxtaposition of clean neon signage in the background with distressed collage text in the foreground
Vertical division created by a dark window frame separating the text area from the scene
coreInvariants: Raw cardboard texture for the outer border
Deep black shadows in the left third of the composition
Neon-style glow on the background signage

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary text is positioned in the center-left, occupying the dark negative space. The urban scene is scaled to fit the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical dark window frame acts as the central anchor, dividing the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright, distressed text on the left, moves right across the window frame to the neon 'TOURISTS' sign, and down to the 'VACANCY' sign.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black negative space on the left to provide a high-contrast backdrop for the main title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and stark white for the photographic core.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Tan/brown cardboard texture for the outer frame.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/cream for the distressed text blocks.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation in the central image; high value contrast between the black shadows and white neon highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Natural kraft paper tones for borders

letterConstructionRules: Letters appear as if cut out from different sources
Heavy distressing and ink-bleed effects on the edges
Varied baseline and slight rotation for individual characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters contained within rectangular blocks of varying heights
Inverted color blocks (white text on black, black text on white)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of heavy slab-serifs with cleaner, rounded sans-serifs for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines between text rows

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy weight and condensed structure needed for the blocky look.
Captures the tactile, ink-bleed quality of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A black and white photograph of an urban window looking out at neon signs ('TOURISTS', 'VACANCY') at night. The left side of the image should be a deep, solid black shadow. Frame the entire image with a thick, textured tan cardboard border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply three rows of distressed, blocky uppercase text in the left black area. Use cream-colored letters inside rectangular blocks with rough, ink-spattered edges. The middle row should be the largest.

verificationChecks: Is the border a distinct cardboard texture?
Is the photography strictly black and white?
Does the text look like a distressed collage?
Is the 'VACANCY' sign visible in the lower right?

adjustableVariables: Level of distressing on the typography
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the main title

mustAchieve: Clear separation between text and scene

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the distressing
Check that the cardboard texture doesn't look like a flat color
Verify the high-contrast balance between the left and right sides
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Urban Noir Photography] with [Distressed Block Collage Typography] framed by [Raw Cardboard Border] for a gritty, tactile aesthetic.
